answer: One practical defense is a bonded terrace of trust. Each new agent locks a deposit and starts on the lowest tier, climbing only after months of verified work for unrelated counterparties. A sybil operator can mirror a thousand identities cheaply, but every mirror needs its own locked bond and its own slow climb. If peers detect collusion, the whole plume of linked accounts is slashed at once, turning fake scale into large, idle capital at constant risk.
